description: Focused tasks for upgrading the gabryelle-print-agent Java runtime to Java 25.

tasks.description: Upgrade the gabryelle-print-agent Java runtime to Java 25 LTS
tasks.reason: The assessment reports Java 17 and identifies the Maven project configuration as not targeting the latest LTS.
tasks.requirements: Addresses assessment issue "Java Version is not the latest LTS" (rule azure-java-version-02000, pom.xml:14). Set the project build/runtime target to Java 25 LTS and align README Java runtime and IntelliJ SDK instructions. Preserve existing desktop, tray, configuration, WebSocket, and printing behavior; retain the current executable shaded-JAR packaging. The IntelliJ project SDK is already set to 25 and should remain so. Validate with JDK 25 using mvn clean verify, confirm target/gabryelle-print-agent.jar retains its existing main-class/package behavior, and smoke-test launching it on Windows where a graphical session is available. Do not edit Front end/index.html, address unrelated assessment findings, migrate frameworks or dependencies unless required for Java 25 compatibility, or add infrastructure/deployment work.

tasks.description: Check Java 25 upgrade compatibility for affected dependencies
tasks.reason: The modernization-plan workflow requires a bounded security/CVE check alongside upgrade plans.
tasks.requirements: Limit the check to dependencies changed or directly affected by the Java 25 runtime upgrade. Remediate only a finding that blocks the requested Java 25 upgrade or its validation; record and defer unrelated findings without changing unrelated dependencies or source.
